user.title: Set up Homeboard
user.description: Homeboard adds a kanban board with projects, issues and an automatic smart-home health check. Everything is managed from the Board panel in the sidebar.

init.title: Homeboard
init.description: Choose what to change. Each section saves when you submit it.

data.checklist_autodone: Move an issue to Done when its checklist is complete
data.panel_admin_only: Only show the panel to administrators
data.tracked_people: People with their own sensors (empty = everyone)

alerts.title: Homeboard: household alerts
alerts.description: Push notifications to the notify services you pick, for example notify.mobile_app_your_phone. Pushes to the person an issue is assigned to are under People and push.

data.notify_done: Tell me when an issue is done
data.notify_overdue: Tell me when an issue is overdue
data.notify_due_soon: Tell me when an issue is due soon
data.notify_health: Tell me about new high-priority auto issues

people.title: Homeboard: people and push
people.description: Each person is notified on their own phone about issues that concern them. Non-urgent pushes wait during quiet hours (and while someone is away, if rhythm learning is on). Times are HH:MM.

data.push_assigned: Tell people when an issue is assigned to them
data.push_comment: Tell people about comments on their issues
data.push_overdue: Tell people when their issues are overdue or due soon
data.push_reported_done: Tell people when an issue they reported is done

person.title: Phone for {person}
person.description: Which notify service reaches {person}? Leave empty to detect it from their device tracker.

files.title: Homeboard: photos, files and Assist
files.description: Attachments are stored privately in config/homeboard_files. Assist sentences are written to homeboard.yaml files in config/custom_sentences (one folder per language) and removed again when switched off.

data.attachments_enabled: Allow photos and PDFs on issues

learning.title: Homeboard: learning
learning.description: Homeboard learns from the board and suggests things (you always decide). Everything stays inside Home Assistant and can be forgotten on the Insights page. Rhythm reads whether each person is home or away, hour by hour, and is off until you switch it on.

data.learn_defaults: Smart defaults (assignee, labels, priority, due date)
data.learn_patterns: Spot repeating tasks and suggest recurring chores

health.title: Homeboard: smart home health
health.description: Homeboard creates issues by itself for things that need fixing and closes them when the fault is gone. Use the scan_health service with dry run to see what it would do before you switch it on.

data.health_project: Project key for auto issues (empty = FIX, created on demand)
data.health_snooze_days: Snooze days when you close an auto issue

create_issue.name: Create issue
create_issue.description: Create an issue on a board. Returns the key. With a dedupe key it never creates the same open issue twice, so it is safe to call from a sensor trigger.

due.name: Due
due.description: Due date (2026-12-01) or date and time with offset.

parent.description: Key of the epic this issue belongs to (empty = none).

status.name: Status
status.description: Status (column) name or id. Default: the first To do status.

dedupe_key.name: Dedupe key
dedupe_key.description: Stable key such as battery_front_door. An open issue with the same key is not created again.

on_duplicate.name: On duplicate
on_duplicate.description: What to do when an open issue with the dedupe key exists (reopen also revives a done one).
